title.description: Panel header title. Set in the app display font when one is defined (--fp-font-display).

subtitle.description: Small line under the title — an identity or status line, not a sentence.

avatar.description: Round mark left of the title.

icon.description: Icon name (host Icon component). Defaults to a built-in spark glyph.

color.description: Mark colour. Defaults to the primary colour.

launcher.description: The launcher button, or false to hide it and drive the panel entirely with setOpen / toggleOpen.

icon.description: Closed-state icon. Defaults to a built-in chat glyph.

label.description: Pill of text beside the launcher while the panel is closed. Hidden on narrow viewports.

ariaLabel.description: Accessible name for the launcher. Always set one when there is no label.

badge.description: Count or dot shown on the launcher. Omit or 0 for none.

height.description: Panel height. Numbers are px. Always clamped to the viewport, so this is a maximum in practice.

expandable.description: Show the expand/collapse control in the header.

closable.description: Show the close control in the header.

placement.description: Which corner the launcher and panel anchor to.

offset.description: Distance from the anchored corner, in px.

zIndex.description: Stacking order of the launcher and panel. The stylesheet default (1100) clears the antd popup layer.

defaultOpen.description: Render with the panel already open on first mount.
